supersedes.note: The open-source release of OmniSI Evolve is this Python package. The Rust engine (Pareto frontier, novelty archive, swap-order judge calibration, sequential early stopping, SHA-256 audit bundles) stays private and is offered only through OmniSI Cloud.

approval.terms: Open-source reusable intelligence infrastructure under Apache-2.0 only (not dual MIT/Apache-2.0). Proprietary customer data, internal evaluation rubrics, business logic and competitive advantages stay private.
approval.scope: Release instruction of 2026-10-16: publish the Python local engine at https://github.com/omnirogue/omnievolve and export no Rust code.

audit.method: Automated scan (oss/verify_apache2_and_scrub.sh omnievolve, including the rust_included check) and scripts/release_check.py; manual review of every file for internal domains and hostnames, credential patterns, proprietary prompts and rubrics, and license declarations; the unit suite and an end-to-end example run from a clean standalone copy.

excluded_private_assets.asset: The OmniRogue Rust Engine: Pareto-frontier selection, novelty archive, swap-order judge calibration, sequential early stopping, SHA-256 audit bundles, the hosted service and its CLI and MCP transport
excluded_private_assets.reason: Competitive advantage; offered only as the hosted OmniSI Cloud service.

excluded_private_assets.asset: Production run specs, sealed internal rubrics and customer replay items
excluded_private_assets.reason: Internal evaluation rubrics and customer data.
Competitive advantage. The LLM mutator and judge prompts in this package were written for it.

excluded_private_assets.asset: Provider credentials, budget limits and pricing

release_blockers.finding: Nobody has yet reviewed the staged repository or approved creating github.com/omnirogue/omnievolve and pushing to it.
release_blockers.required_fix: A maintainer reviews the staged repository, sets publication_ready to true and removes this blocker; then the repository is created and pushed.

verification.command: python3 scripts/release_check.py && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
verified: 2026-10-16, macOS, Python 3.12.1: all 65 tests in tests/ pass; ruff 0.16.1 check and format are clean; every module parses and the package imports on Python 3.10 and 3.13.

From a clean standalone copy of this directory, PYTHONPATH=<copy> python3 -m omnievolve run --config examples/heuristic_tuning/omnievolve.json --generations 5: F1 rose from 0.553571 (seed) to 0.739796 in under a second; the ledger held 1 run, 63 candidates, 66 lineage edges, 12 generation rows and 2 islands; leaderboard, report (two inline SVG charts, no scripts or external resources) and export-winner succeeded; the exported patch applied with git apply and the patched triage.py re-scored 0.739796.
examples/prompt_evolution with its own settings: 0.660714 (seed) to 0.958929 in 10 generations.

bash oss/verify_apache2_and_scrub.sh omnievolve and --self-test pass, including the rust_included check and the public-name allowlist cases; scripts/release_check.py passes; the package contains no .rs, Cargo.toml or Cargo.lock file.
unverified: The CI workflow has not run on GitHub Actions: the public repository does not exist yet.
The LLM mutator and judge were tested against recorded provider response shapes only; no live OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini or Ollama call was made.
The OmniSI Cloud bridge was tested with a fake transport and --dry-run; it has not been run against a live OmniSI Cloud endpoint.
